universal_rules_markdown:
# Central Cultivation Insight Rules — R3 Body-Integrated Candidate

Cultivation Insights are one central character-option system shared across Paths, Spheres, Subpaths, inheritances, offices, pacts, scars, mutations, and cultivated realizations. A Path may provide Insight selection levels, but no Path owns a separate Insight subsystem.

## Level selection

At CL4, CL8, CL12, CL16, and CL19, when a Path progression offers an Ability Score Improvement or Cultivation Insight, choose one:

- take the normal Ability Score Improvement; or
- select one Cultivation Insight for which you meet every prerequisite.

A level-selected Insight grants its printed benefit and increases one ability score listed in **Ability Increase (Level Selection)** by 1, to the maximum permitted by the character's current Realm.

An Insight gained through a manual, tribulation, relic, shrine, spirit pact, sect instruction, bloodline awakening, reincarnated memory, office, experimentation, story reward, or another non-level source grants only its cultivation benefit unless that source expressly grants the ability increase.

## General limits

- Meet every printed prerequisite when the Insight is gained.
- Unless marked **Repeatable**, select an Insight once.
- A Path affinity, role tag, suggested Subpath, or AI recommendation is search metadata only and never grants access.
- If an Insight grants a new Sphere, gain the normal free talent granted whenever a character learns a new Sphere. The Insight does not waive Secret, Restricted, inherited, ethical, initiation, or narrative access.
- Use the effective Source CL identified by the Insight. If none is printed, use the Source CL of the Path, Sphere, Subpath, item, pact, or other Source Rule supplying the effect.
- A Path-resource or Cultivation Point cost cannot be reduced below 1 unless a rule expressly permits 0. Cost reductions do not stack on one activation unless expressly allowed.
- Copying, repeating, accelerating, or extending a technique does not waive consumed materials, sacrifices, Corruption, Impurity, item charges, maximum-resource costs, vows, Offerings, or other nonstandard prices.
- An Insight does not duplicate a weapon, Artifact, consumable, Companion, spirit, Formation Anchor, body Asset, or other cultivated Asset.
- One activation cannot deliver the same attack, poison, weapon rider, Insight rider, or Forged Technique rider multiple times unless the Source Rule expressly authorizes and prices each delivery.

## Body-linked rules

Body-linked Insights use Body Refining Core R2 for Path features, Body Refining Shared Procedures R1 for anatomy, Injury, reconstruction, transformation, natural weapons, integrated weapons, bodily Assets, mitigation, movement, restraint, external projection, Realm Suppression, and Foundation interaction, and Body Refining Subpath Procedure Addendum R7 for Subpath-specific states and interfaces.

A Body-linked Insight does not create external projection unless it records an origin, range, legal target, action and cost, attack or save, duration, line of effect, medium, Source CL, and suppression procedure. Additional limbs or anatomy do not create extra actions or attacks unless printed. Regeneration and body-material production cannot be farmed for unlimited resources.

## Spirit-linked rules

Spirit-linked Insights continue to use Spirit Awakening Core R2A, Spirit Awakening Rules Reference R3, the Universal Bonded Companions Combat Chassis R2, and the Spirit Companions Sphere where applicable. Existing Spirit R2 normalizations remain authoritative and are preserved by this revision.

## Central Insight execution definitions

These definitions apply whenever an Insight uses one of the following terms.

### Qualifying hostile source

A creature, hazard, Asset, Anchor, or effect is a **qualifying hostile source** when all of the following are true:

- it is not controlled by you or a willing ally;
- it was not created, invited, or damaged solely to trigger the Insight;
- it is acting against you, an ally, or a scene objective; and
- its Source CL is no more than 5 lower than yours, or it can inflict Hit Point loss, a condition, forced movement, resource loss, objective loss, or another printed consequence that matters in the current scene.

### Qualifying creature

A **qualifying creature** is an independent creature with a complete creature record that is not an illusory duplicate, disposable training construct, harmless summon, or closed-loop resource source. It qualifies if its Source CL is no more than 5 lower than yours or it is named, controls a scene objective, carries a relevant oath or relationship, or can impose a printed consequence on the scene.

### Qualifying event or meaningful scene

An event or scene qualifies when at least one of the following is true:

- a qualifying hostile source participates;
- failure can cause Hit Point loss, Cultivation Point loss, a condition, item or Asset loss, positional loss, mission failure, legal or sectarian consequence, or a change to an oath, debt, Bond, or custody record;
- the event creates, ends, or materially changes a project, relationship, Injury, transformation, or spiritual state; or
- a Source Rule expressly identifies it as qualifying.

Staged exchanges, willing damage loops, repeated harmless tests, and effects created solely to refund their own cost do not qualify.

### Recorded legal access

A choice that requires **recorded legal access** must identify the manual, teacher, lineage, office, license, relic, pact, sect permission, bloodline, or other Source Rule that grants access. A Path affinity, recommendation, or thematic similarity is not access.

### Project contribution

An Insight that contributes a principle, Mandate, presentation, technique, or tool to a project does not create the project by itself. The project record must state its objective, work time, materials, contributors, Source CL, maintenance, and vulnerability. Unless the Insight prints another benefit, one qualifying contribution grants one of the following once per project phase:

- Advantage on one project check made by a contributor;
- a reduction of 10 percent in the remaining ordinary labor time; or
- qualification as one required trained contributor or required conceptual component.

The same Insight cannot grant more than one of these benefits to the same project phase.

### Ordinary, higher-authority, and stronger effects

An **ordinary** effect is a non-Secret effect whose Source CL is no higher than yours. A **higher-authority** or **stronger** effect has a higher Source CL, is Secret or Artifact authority, or expressly overrides the relevant defense. These terms never permit the adjudicator to invent a new immunity or cost.

### Insight dormancy and restitution

When an Insight states that violating its discipline makes it dormant, its ability-score increase remains. Its cultivation benefit becomes inactive until the listed restitution is completed. Unless the Insight prints another restitution, the default is a Full Cultivation Session devoted to reflection plus one concrete corrective act toward a creature or community harmed by the violation.

### Insight cadence

- **Once per scene** resets when a new scene begins.
- **Once between Full Cultivation Sessions** resets only after completing a Full Cultivation Session.
- A **10-minute preparation or recovery procedure** requires uninterrupted work and cannot be completed during Initiative unless a rule expressly permits it.
- A prepared choice that lasts until the next Full Cultivation Session remains active through ordinary rests.

records.name: Expanded Dantian
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+  
**Repeatable:** Twice

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Increase your maximum Qi by:

`2 × your Proficiency Bonus`

Recalculate this increase whenever your Proficiency Bonus changes.

If selected twice, both increases apply.

records.name: Meridian Economy
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, after a Qi-powered feature resolves successfully and you actually paid at least 2 Qi for that activation, regain 1 Qi.

Meridian Economy:

- Resolves after the complete feature.
- Does not reduce the feature's cost.
- Does not trigger from refunded Qi.
- Does not trigger when the final amount actually paid was 0 or 1 Qi.
- Cannot trigger itself or create a closed refund loop.
- Functions alongside Golden Core Efficiency because it is recovery rather than a cost reduction.

records.name: Thunderstep
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, immediately after you spend Qi on a feature that resolves successfully, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

At CL12, this movement may:

- Travel vertically along a wall.
- Cross an unsupported gap.
- Move across a liquid surface.

You must end on a legal supporting surface unless another feature supports you.

If Circulating Golden Core also triggers, you may use both movements or combine them into one continuous movement.

---

records.name: Fivefold Conversion
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When activating a Qi-powered feature that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, spend 1 additional Qi to change any amount of that damage to another type from the same list.

Declare the conversion before attack rolls or saving throws are resolved.

The conversion:

- Changes damage type.
- Does not automatically change the feature's Sphere, elemental, weather, or metaphysical tags.
- Does not add a rider belonging to the new damage type.
- Applies once across a Barrage, area, or multiattack activation.
- May convert technique damage delivered through a weapon, but does not convert ordinary weapon damage unless the delivery rule explicitly permits it.

At CL16, you may instead spend 2 additional Qi to convert the chosen damage to Force.

---

records.name: Meridian Overchannel
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when a Qi-powered feature deals damage or restores Hit Points, spend additional Qi up to your Proficiency Bonus.

Add `1d8` to one damage or healing roll for each additional Qi spent.

For every Qi spent beyond the first 2, take `1d8` Force strain after the feature resolves.

Force strain from this Insight:

- Cannot be reduced.
- Cannot be prevented.
- Cannot be redirected.
- Cannot be converted into another damage type.
- Cannot generate Qi, charges, Temporary Hit Points, or retaliatory effects.

Meridian Overchannel adds dice to one roll, not once per target, projectile, attack, or healing recipient.

---

records.name: Elemental Counterflow
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi

Gain Resistance to the triggering damage type against that damage packet.

After damage resolves, choose one:

- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Attack before the end of your next turn.
- Your next damaging Qi-powered feature before the end of your next turn may deal the triggering damage type.
- Move your Domain Armament up to 20 feet.

Elemental Counterflow cannot respond to damage you willingly dealt to yourself solely to trigger it.

---

records.name: Qi Devourer
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When an essence-bearing creature within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points after you damaged it during the current scene, you may consume a portion of its escaping cultivated essence without using an action.

Regain Qi equal to the lower of:

- Your Proficiency Bonus.
- The creature's CL, minimum 1.

You may use Qi Devourer once per round.

A creature yields essence to you once until its life-force, spirit, or cultivation has been fully restored. Repeatedly reviving the same depleted creature does not refresh it unless the restoration effect explicitly rebuilds the consumed essence.

A construct, illusion, projected clone, summoned disposable body, or creature you created solely as a refund engine does not yield essence unless it possesses an independent genuine soul, life-force, or cultivation source.

Qi Devourer can be used on captives, condemned enemies, sacrificial victims, or willing donors when they genuinely possess consumable essence. Such use may be criminal, forbidden, praised, tolerated, or condemned according to the culture involved; it does not automatically gain the Daemonic tag.

---

records.name: Heaven's Conduit
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Bonus Action**  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Regain 10 Qi and gain 1 level of Exhaustion.

The Exhaustion:

- Cannot be prevented.
- Cannot be transferred.
- Cannot be removed before the current scene ends.
- Can accumulate if you use Heaven's Conduit in later scenes before recovering.

If the regained Qi would exceed your maximum, the excess becomes unstable overflow that disappears at the end of the current turn.

---

records.name: Meridian Fortress
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on saving throws and Cultivation Checks against:

- Qi drain.
- Maximum-Qi reduction.
- Meridian sealing.
- Forced cost increases.
- Cultivation Point theft.
- Effects preventing Qi recovery.

Once per round, when a hostile effect would reduce your current Qi or maximum Qi, reduce that loss by your Proficiency Bonus.

If you possess Stable Golden Core, add this reduction to Stable Golden Core's reduction. This is an explicit stacking exception.

Meridian Fortress does not reduce Qi you willingly spend or sacrifice.

---

records.name: Refined Meridian Regulation
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Meridian Regulation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Meridian Regulation gains a range of 10 feet when used through direct Qi projection, a needle, a medical implement, or your Domain Armament.

You may also target:

- Charmed caused by a poison, drug, disease, bodily parasite, or meridian disturbance.
- Blinded or Deafened caused by smoke, ash, poison, pressure, or a directly impaired organ.
- One ordinary Bleeding effect.
- One temporary meridian blockage.

Against an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours, a successful repeated save also suppresses its ongoing damage until the end of the target's next turn.

This Insight does not allow Meridian Regulation to remove a Curse, Tribulation, Foundation Injury, Hidden Injury, permanent transformation, completed possession, Soul Damage, or conceptual severance unless another Source Rule expressly expands it.

records.name: Restorative Circulation
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when a Qi-powered feature restores Hit Points to one or more creatures, choose one recipient.

Increase the healing it receives by your Proficiency Bonus.

If the target is already at maximum Hit Points after the healing, it instead gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

At CL12, when the chosen target is at 0 Hit Points, increase the healing by `2 × your Proficiency Bonus` instead.

Restorative Circulation applies once per activation, not once per healing die, target, pulse, or repeated tick.

records.name: Qi-Tempered Concentration
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain a Qi-powered feature.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi

Add your Proficiency Bonus to the saving throw, potentially turning failure into success.

This is not saving throw proficiency and cannot modify the same saving throw more than once.

At CL15, this Insight improves Independent Concentration:

- Independent Concentration may protect any cultivation feature you maintain, not only a Qi feature.
- When Independent Concentration turns failure into success, choose one: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, move your Domain Armament 10 feet, or gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

**Repeatable:** Choose a different weapon group each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one weapon group with which you are proficient.

When you make a weapon attack specifically to deliver a Qi-powered cultivation technique through a weapon from that group, you may use your Qi Cultivation key ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for:

- The delivery attack roll.
- The weapon's damage modifier on that qualifying attack.

This Insight does not change ordinary attacks made without weapon delivery.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, gain one Weave benefit:

- After you hit with a weapon attack, gain +1 to the next Cultivation Attack you make before the end of your next turn.
- After a creature fails a saving throw against your Qi-powered technique, gain +1 to the next weapon attack you make before the end of your next turn.
- After you activate a Qi-powered technique through a weapon, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target struck or affected.

Only one Weave benefit may be active at a time. Gaining another replaces the previous benefit.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

This Insight grants no armor or shield proficiency.

While wearing armor or using a shield with which you are proficient:

- Gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone.
- Reduce forced movement affecting you by 5 feet.
- Once per round, after you spend Qi on a feature that resolves successfully, reduce the next damage packet you take before the start of your next turn by your Proficiency Bonus.

High-quality armor, heavy armor, and shields do not interfere with your Qi techniques unless a specific item, curse, Method, or Source Rule says otherwise.

**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, proficiency with a two-handed heavy weapon or another weapon classified as a heavy armament, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when you hit with a heavy weapon while delivering a Qi-powered cultivation technique, spend 1 additional Qi to apply Heavy Conduction.

Add the weapon's base damage dice one additional time to that hit.

Against an unattended object, vehicle, structure, temporary barrier, Formation Anchor, or Cultivation Asset, also choose one:

- Treat Damage Threshold as 0 for the hit.
- Ignore ordinary Resistance to the weapon's damage.
- Push or displace the target section 5 feet when physically possible.
- Deal an additional `2d8` Force damage.

Heavy Conduction applies only to the first qualifying attack unless another rule expressly extends it.

**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, CL12+, and a Barrage Sphere talent, multiattack Recorded Art, or another authorized multiattack cultivation procedure

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a weapon-delivered cultivation technique would normally apply only to the first qualifying attack in an authorized Barrage, volley, or multiattack sequence, you may extend it.

Before making any attacks, pay:

`1 additional Qi for each additional attack that will carry the technique`

You may extend the technique to a maximum number of attacks equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Unless the technique explicitly states otherwise:

- A once-per-activation rider still applies once.
- Qi Technique Potency still applies once.
- A missed attack does not deliver the technique.
- Each attack must satisfy the weapon and target requirements.
- Additional attacks cannot generate more additional attacks.

records.category: Qi — Martial and Domain Armament Insights
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Domain Armament, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Your Domain Armament improves:

- Control range increases by 30 feet.
- Movement increases by 15 feet.
- Calling or releasing a bound item may occur at any point during your turn without using an action, once per turn.

Once per turn when your Domain Armament hits, choose one:

- Push or pull the target 5 feet.
- The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move the Armament 10 feet.
- Reveal the target with visible Qi until the start of your next turn; Invisible does not conceal it from you.
- Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Attack against that target before the end of your next turn.

**Trigger:** The protected creature is hit by an attack roll.  
**Cost:** 1 Qi

`2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`

`3d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`

Guardian Armament can protect against melee or ranged attack rolls, but it does not apply to saving-throw effects or automatic damage.

- Move one willing creature in the Formation 5 feet.
- Extend one Formation line by 5 feet.
- Reveal one creature touching a Formation boundary.

**Repeatable:** Choose a different elemental Sphere each time

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one elemental Sphere you know.

At the end of a Full Cultivation Session, choose one mutation. It remains until you complete another Full Cultivation Session and choose again.

### Resistant Mutation

Gain Resistance to one damage type directly associated with the Sphere.

### Violent Mutation

Once per turn, one damaging feature from the Sphere deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

### Driving Mutation

Increase one forced movement caused by the Sphere by 10 feet once per turn.

### Flowing Mutation

Once per turn after activating a feature from the Sphere, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

### Sheltering Mutation

Once per turn after activating a feature from the Sphere, you or one affected ally gains Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.

### Expansive Mutation

Once per turn, increase one radius or cone by 5 feet or one line by 10 feet.

A single activation benefits from one mutation granted by this Insight.

---

records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Elemental Mastery, CL16+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 6 Qi

Create a Dominion of the damage type chosen for Elemental Mastery.

For the duration:

- Your Qi-powered features of the selected type may originate from any point inside the Dominion.
- Allies you choose gain Resistance to the selected type while inside.
- The first time during each turn that a hostile creature takes the selected damage inside, it takes additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- An ordinary environmental expression of the element obeys your printed direction inside the area.

When a hostile persistent elemental effect of an opposing or incompatible type overlaps the Dominion:

- If its Source CL is lower than yours, suppress it in the overlap.
- If its Source CL is equal to or higher than yours, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On success, suppress it in the overlap until the start of your next turn.

Elemental Dominion is a Qi field, not a Spirit Awakening Domain.

---

### Single-Target Compression

If the feature affects exactly one target, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll and increase its save DC by 1.

Reduce one printed area dimension by at least 5 feet. Add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll against one target in the reduced area and subtract 1 from the first saving throw made against it.

records.prerequisites: Qi Devourer, access to a forbidden or predatory manual, CL12+
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Devourer, access to a forbidden or predatory manual, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When Qi Devourer consumes essence from a sentient creature, you may take a deeper soul fragment.

If you do:

- regain 4 additional Qi;
- learn one dominant emotion, unresolved oath, major fear, or active spiritual allegiance carried by the victim; and
- the victim suffers **Soul Depletion**.

### Soul Depletion

Until repaired, the victim has Disadvantage on its first saving throw in each scene against possession, dream intrusion, emotional manipulation, or soul damage; cannot yield another soul fragment to you; and displays a visible spiritual wound to Qi Sensing.

Soul Depletion is repaired by one of the following:

- a 1-hour spiritual treatment that succeeds on a Medicine or Cultivation Check against your Qi Cultivation Save DC;
- Spiritual Exorcism whose Source CL is at least yours;
- a Full Cultivation Session performed under a soul-repair Method, Foundation, Spirit, or Samsara Source Rule whose Source CL is at least yours; or
- another Source Rule that expressly repairs Soul Depletion.

This Insight does not trap the complete soul or prevent resurrection unless another higher-authority Source Rule expressly does so.

records.name: Nightmare Feaster
records.category: Qi — Forbidden, Condemned, and Predatory Insights
records.prerequisites: Dream Qi Cultivator or Dreams Sphere, CL12+
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Dream Qi Cultivator or Dreams Sphere, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Dream-, Nightmare-, Sleep-, Fear-, or dream-illusion effects, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per round.

### Predatory Dream Harvest

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch or shared dream connection  
**Target:** One sleeping, unconscious, restrained, willing, or otherwise accessible genuine dreamer

Drain the target's active dream substance.

The target makes a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, its choice, unless willing.

- **Failed Save:** Regain Qi equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The target suffers one Dream Trauma.
- **Successful Save:** Regain 1 Qi. The target wakes and knows an intrusion occurred.

A Dream Trauma imposes one of the following, chosen when harvested:

- `2d8` Psychic damage that cannot be healed until the target completes a Full Cultivation Session devoted to recovery.
- Maximum Hit Points reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until cultivated treatment.
- One level of Exhaustion.
- Loss of one specific recent memory until dream therapy or restoration.
- Disadvantage on the next saving throw against Dreams or Fear.

A creature may suffer a number of Dream Traumas equal to its Proficiency Bonus.

When its Dream Traumas reach that maximum:

- It becomes comatose and cannot wake naturally until at least one Trauma is removed.
- A further failed harvest deals `4d8` Psychic damage and reduces its Hit Point maximum by the same amount.
- If this maximum-Hit-Point reduction reaches its normal Hit Point maximum, the creature dies and its dreaming consciousness is consumed or scattered.

A Dream Trauma is removed by one of the following: a 1-hour dream-therapy procedure that succeeds on a Wisdom (Medicine), Wisdom (Insight), or Cultivation Check against your Qi Cultivation Save DC; Spiritual Exorcism or memory restoration whose Source CL is at least yours; a Full Cultivation Session under a Dreams or Samsara Source Rule whose Source CL is at least yours; or another Source Rule that expressly repairs Dream Trauma.

A self-created dream construct, illusory sleeper, or closed refund loop provides no Qi unless it possesses independent genuine consciousness.

The practice may be called demonic by the Empire or other institutions, but it gains the Daemonic tag only from a separate rule.

---

When you die and your soul remains capable of entering Samsara, create a Samsara Anchor at your place of death.

For the next 1 minute:

- Your soul cannot be involuntarily consumed or redirected by an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- An ally may touch the Anchor and spend an Action to preserve it.
- A resurrection, soul-return, or Samsara feature may originate from the Anchor.

When the Anchor is created, you may return through it with 1 Hit Point at the start of your next turn.

- You complete a successful Realm breakthrough.

- You permanently reduce your maximum Qi by your Proficiency Bonus.

A permanent maximum-Qi reduction paid this way can be repaired only by a feature explicitly capable of restoring permanent cultivation sacrifice.

This does not overcome conceptual erasure, a severed Samsara connection, destruction of the soul, or an effect of superior authority without a successful Source CL contest.

records.name: Formation-Collapse Survivor
records.prerequisites: Survive a Formation collapse, spatial collapse, teleportation disaster, or prison Formation Tribulation
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Survive a Formation collapse, spatial collapse, teleportation disaster, or prison Formation Tribulation

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Gain Advantage on checks and saving throws to:

- Escape Formations.
- Resist unwilling teleportation.
- Locate spatial faults.
- Survive collapsing pocket spaces.

When trapped, sealed, or spatially isolated, you immediately learn the direction of the nearest vulnerable Anchor, boundary fault, exit route, or unstable spatial seam within 300 feet, if one exists.

Once per scene, spend 3 Qi to move up to 15 feet through one Formation boundary or spatial seam whose Source CL is lower than yours.

Against an equal or higher Source CL, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

records.name: Heaven's Scar
records.prerequisites: Survive an extraordinary, unique, Secret, Immortal, or Heaven-recognized Tribulation; approval
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Survive an extraordinary, unique, Secret, Immortal, or Heaven-recognized Tribulation and record the Tribulation's Source CL and authority

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one Scar expression that directly matches the recorded Tribulation:

1. **Resistant Scar.** Gain Resistance to one damage type dealt by the Tribulation. Once per round after a qualifying hostile source deals that type to you, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
2. **Unbowed Scar.** Gain Advantage on saving throws against one named category of suppression used by the Tribulation.
3. **Scar-Step.** Once during each of your turns after you spend Qi, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
4. **Heaven-Refusing Scar.** Once per scene, when a lower-Source-CL effect would forcibly transform, banish, possess, or kill you, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On a success, the effect fails against you.
5. **Witness Scar.** You can perceive one specific heavenly, spatial, karmic, or elemental phenomenon demonstrated by the Tribulation within 1 mile when it is not concealed by a higher-Source-CL effect.
6. **Matching Feature Scar.** Choose one printed feature from a Tribulation Subpath you possess. Increase one printed once-per-scene use by one, or improve one numerical result by your Proficiency Bonus. Record the exact feature and improvement when this Insight is gained.

Record the Scar's visible sign, mechanical tag, Source CL, expression, and any ongoing price printed by the Tribulation source. No unlisted custom expression is available without a separate published record.

records.name: Breath-Thread Listener
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Air sphere, Spirit Awakening, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Wisdom, or Intelligence score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Source CL:** Use your Spirit Awakening CL for Breath Reading and the normal Air Source CL for Air talents.

You hear the spiritual thread carried by breath, speech, and suppressed panic.

You have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks against a creature within 30 feet that you can hear breathing or speaking.

### Breath Reading

**Action Type:** No Action  
**Trigger:** A creature within 30 feet that you can hear knowingly speaks a false statement, begins an audible command or compulsion technique, or attempts to conceal immediate fear or panic  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Learn which one of the following states best describes the triggering breath:

- **Steady:** The creature's breath does not reveal deliberate falsehood, immediate panic, or coercive command pressure.
- **Strained:** The creature is afraid, under duress, injured, or suppressing panic.
- **False:** The spoken statement deliberately conflicts with what the creature presently believes. This does not detect omission, metaphor, mistake, or technically true misdirection.
- **Absent:** The creature has no living breath, is using an artificial voice, or is speaking through a body that does not breathe normally.
- **Spiritually Masked:** A cultivation effect is concealing or falsifying the breath-thread.

If a masking effect has lower Source CL than you, you identify both the underlying state and that it was masked. Otherwise, make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the masking effect's Cultivation Save DC. On a success, identify the underlying state. On a failure, learn only **Spiritually Masked**.

Breath Reading does not read thoughts, reveal the complete truth, identify an unknown technique by name, or force the creature to speak.

**Source CL:** The Source CL of Mandate Axe Presence.

When you make a public declaration through **Mandate Axe Presence**, name one lawful group, sect, clan, office, army, sworn band, protected settlement, or another recorded authority with defined membership and jurisdiction that you actually represent.

You have Advantage on the Axes Check if at least one listener satisfies either condition:

- **Recognized Authority:** The listener knows your office or affiliation, has been shown a genuine credential, standard, seal, witness, or insignia, or has previously seen that authority lawfully exercised.
- **Feared Consequences:** The listener reasonably believes the named authority can investigate, punish, protect, mobilize, or retaliate within the current situation.

### Dishonored Mandate

If you knowingly use this Insight to pronounce a materially false judgment and the falsehood is publicly exposed, you gain **Dishonored Mandate** and cannot benefit from this Insight.

Remove Dishonored Mandate by completing one public restitution scene that includes:

1. acknowledging or correcting the false judgment before the harmed party, represented group, or a recognized witness; and
2. completing one of the following: material compensation, an accepted office punishment, a formal apology and retraction, or a Karma or purification procedure that expressly settles the abuse.

A declaration made from incomplete information is not a false judgment unless you knowingly represented uncertain information as established fact.

records.name: Heart-Devil Negotiator
records.prerequisites: Daemonic Cultivation and either Spirit Awakening or Wisdom 14+, CL5+
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Daemonic Cultivation and either Spirit Awakening or Wisdom 14+, CL5+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

### Bargain with the Inner Demon

**Action Type:** No Action  
**Trigger:** You would gain one or more Corruption from a single event  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Make a Wisdom (Insight) check against `DC 12 + your current Corruption` before applying the triggering Corruption.

**Success:** Delay the triggering Corruption until the current scene ends. Record its amount and source. When the scene ends, gain all Corruption delayed by this Insight simultaneously. Ending, suppressing, or bargaining with the source does not erase the delayed amount unless that Source Rule expressly removes Corruption already incurred.

**Failure:** Gain the Corruption immediately and record one **Temptation**. Choose or roll `1d6`:

| d6 | Temptation |
|---:|---|
| 1 | Conceal the Corruption or its source from an ally or authority. |
| 2 | Seize, consume, protect, or study the object or essence that caused it. |
| 3 | Accept a further offer of power, knowledge, or access from the source. |
| 4 | Isolate yourself from anyone likely to interfere. |
| 5 | Spare, obey, imitate, or bargain with the entity behind the Corruption. |
| 6 | Prove your superiority through an unnecessary risk, contest, or display. |

A Temptation is a recorded impulse, not control. It cannot compel an action, impose a condition, or create additional Corruption unless another Source Rule says so. It ends with the scene.

An effect that expressly says its Corruption cannot be delayed overrides this Insight.

- the activation deals no damage;
- a target currently possessing an unwilling Host, desecrating remains, or preventing a soul from following its lawful afterlife or reincarnation route has Disadvantage on its saving throw against the activation; and

The question does not compel an answer, suspend hostile action beyond the talent's normal resolution, reveal hidden information automatically, or change the target's legal destination.

records.name: Breach-Reader
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Destruction sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Spend 1 minute studying one visible object, wall, barrier, lock, Formation Anchor, gate, or structural defense within 30 feet.

Make an Intelligence (Investigation) check or Cultivation Check against the target's Cultivation Save DC. If it has no save DC, use `10 + its Source CL + its quality modifier`, where the quality modifier is 0 for ordinary construction, +2 for reinforced or cultivated construction, and +5 for Artifact, Secret, or masterwork construction.

On a success, choose and learn one:

- the most vulnerable visible section;
- whether it has Resistance or Immunity to one damage type you can deal;
- whether destroying it is likely to create a breach, collapse, alarm, or printed backlash; or
- one tool, Sphere, or damage category that bypasses a printed defense it possesses.

On a failure, learn only whether its Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours.

records.name: Soul-Return Witness
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Life sphere, Spirit Awakening

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Constitution, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use **Read the Pulse** on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day, also diagnose the soul's apparent return state. Learn one:

- **Willing:** A Complete Soul appears willing and ordinarily capable of return.
- **Unwilling:** The soul appears to refuse ordinary return.
- **Absent:** No returnable Complete Soul is present or reachable by the examined pattern.
- **Trapped:** A creature, vessel, location, Domain, Spiritual Anchor, or custody effect is restraining the soul.
- **Consumed or Destroyed:** The pattern shows loss beyond ordinary absence; this diagnosis does not itself prove permanent destruction.
- **Blocked:** An authority, reincarnation route, afterlife custody, oath, Secret, artifact, or other effect prevents ordinary return.

If the restraining or blocking source has lower Source CL than the higher of your Life and Spirit Awakening Source CL, also learn whether it is sustained by a creature, vessel, location, Domain, Bond, or Spiritual Anchor.

If the source is within 2 Source CL of you, learn its broad category and whether it is present, distant, or outside the current plane.

If the source is 3 or more Source CL higher, Secret, Immortal, divine, or world-law authority, learn only that a higher authority is involved and whether ordinary return is presently possible.

This Insight does not identify an unknown captor by name, reveal a hidden release condition, return the soul, or establish that reconstruction is possible.
records.source_cl_basis: Higher of your Life and Spirit Awakening Source CL for diagnosis only

records.name: Song-Soul Oathbearer
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Awakening, Music sphere, CL10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Dexterity score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When one of your Music talents with the **Soul-Sound** tag affects a willing ally, that ally may voluntarily reveal one oath, fear, grief, vow, or emotional burden through symbolic sound.

Record only the category the ally chose and any details it willingly communicates. The sound cannot expose undisclosed memories, compel confession, or reveal thoughts.

If the ally reveals a burden, choose one benefit for that activation:

- it has Advantage on one saving throw against Frightened made before the end of its next turn;
- it gains Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`; or
- you have Advantage on your next Wisdom check made before the scene ends to understand, counsel, reconcile with, or negotiate with that ally concerning the revealed subject.

A single Music activation grants no more than one benefit from this Insight, even if it affects the ally multiple times.

This Insight does not grant general Qi projection, create a puppet action, or waive Puppetry command and line-of-effect rules.

records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Sabers sphere, Spirit Awakening, one named saber focus

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

### Blade-Listening Rite

**Action Type:** Cultivation Procedure  
**Time:** 10 uninterrupted minutes while holding or touching your named saber focus  
**Limit:** Once per scene for each named saber

Ask one question concerning a battle, execution, oath, fear, pursuit, wielder, or target connected to the saber within the last 7 days.

The saber answers through one symbolic omen chosen from the following forms:

- **Direction:** toward, away, above, below, encircling, or nowhere.
- **Pressure:** safe, threatened, dominant, wounded, restrained, or absent.
- **Relationship:** hunter, quarry, ally, betrayer, witness, or stranger.
- **Outcome:** victory, escape, capture, death, interruption, or unresolved.
- **Emotion:** duty, fear, hatred, grief, loyalty, or hunger.

The omen must reflect information the saber genuinely witnessed, carried, spiritually recorded, or received through its recognized bond. If it has no qualifying information, the answer is **silent**. A sealed, altered, or higher-authority memory may instead answer **obscured**.

The rite does not provide names, exact locations, complete conversations, hidden statistics, or facts the saber never perceived.

records.name: Soul-Hearing Listener
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Soul-Echo Hearing, Spirit Awakening, CL10+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Charisma, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you use **Soul-Echo Hearing**, choose one willing creature whose natural or spiritual voice you have heard within the last day. Establish a **Listening Link** with that creature.

The link lasts until you establish it with another creature, the creature withdraws consent while able to communicate that choice, or a Source Rule severs it.

While the linked creature is within 1 mile and on the same plane, you become aware when its state changes into or out of any of the following:

- **Possessed:** It is under unwilling Possession or coercive Hosting.
- **Silenced:** It is unable to produce its normal voice because of a condition, restraint, injury, Silence effect, or spiritual suppression.
- **Screaming:** It audibly or spiritually cries out because of immediate pain, terror, soul harm,.
- **Fallen:** It is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

You learn the state and the direction of the link, but not exact distance or location.

A ward, Domain, planar boundary, or concealment effect can block the link. If the blocking source has lower Source CL than the higher of your Sound and Spirit Awakening Source CL, you know the link is blocked and its direction immediately before the block. Otherwise, you know only that contact was lost.

The link does not transmit speech, thoughts, ordinary emotions, damage details, or continuous sensory information.

records.name: Spirit-Broker Reputation
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Use the following **Spirit Negotiation Position** ladder:

`Hostile → Unwilling → Wary → Open → Favorable`

When a spirit knows your reputation for keeping spirit covenants, begin its first negotiation with you during a scene one position more favorable than its ordinary starting position, to a maximum of Favorable.

A spirit knows your reputation if one of the following is true:

- it has dealt with you before;
- a spirit, shrine, court, ancestor, broker, sect, or witness it trusts has vouched for you;
- your relevant office, seal, lineage, or public covenant record is recognized in its community.

### Broken Reputation

If you have an unresolved breach of a Covenant Bond, Offering, Taboo, spirit-court judgment, or other recorded spirit agreement, this Insight provides no benefit to spirits that know of that breach.

Restore the benefit for that breach by completing its recorded Restitution. If no Restitution was recorded, complete all three:

1. acknowledge the breach to the harmed spirit or its recognized representative;
2. provide the missed Offering, compensation, service, or release that reasonably repairs the terms; and
3. receive acceptance from the harmed spirit, its lawful successor, or a recognized neutral spirit authority.

This Insight never changes a spirit's consent, core Nature, sworn hostility, or response to an impossible request.

records.name: Vessel Artisan
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have Advantage on checks to prepare, repair, disguise, identify, or reinforce a spirit vessel, shrine, charm, mask, weapon, puppet, reliquary, or Spiritual Anchor.

### Craft Minor Vessel

**Action Type:** Downtime Procedure  
**Time:** 8 hours of work  
**Materials:** ordinary clay, wood, stone, cloth, metal, glass, bone, wax, inked paper, or another material listed in the spirit's Nature record; no rare cultivation material is required

Create one Tiny or Small minor vessel whose material matches at least one tag in the willing minor spirit's Nature record or one Minor Spirit Agreement.

Record:

- the vessel's object type and material;
- the spirit or Nature it is intended to receive;
- its entrance and release procedure;
- one visible or spiritual sign that it is occupied; and
- its ordinary object AC and Hit Points. If no object rule supplies them, use AC 12 and Hit Points equal to `5 + 2 × your Proficiency Bonus`.

The vessel:

- can shelter, transport, conceal, or localize its recorded spirit;
- does not grant a combat body, attack, independent turn, Nature Expression, resistance, or Companion statistics;
- cannot contain an unwilling Complete Soul without a legal Binding source; and
- expels its occupant into the nearest legal state if destroyed, unless another Source Rule governs destruction.

You may repair a minor vessel during 1 hour of work with ordinary materials, restoring all of its Hit Points if its spiritual structure has not been destroyed by a higher-authority effect.

records.name: Shared Breath Guardian
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Companions sphere

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

**Action Type:** Reaction  
**Trigger:** A spirit joined to you by a Covenant Bond, Hosting Bond, Major Spirit Bond, or full Spirit Companion relationship and within 30 feet would take damage

Transfer half of the triggering damage to yourself.

Resolve the transfer in this order:

1. Determine the damage after modifiers that apply to the original damage source but before applying the spirit's Resistance, Immunity, or Vulnerability.
2. If the spirit is Hosted in you, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 0.
3. Divide the remaining damage in half. You receive the smaller half, rounded down; the spirit receives the remainder.
4. Apply your own Resistance, Immunity, and Vulnerability to your share and the spirit's to its share.

The transferred share retains its original damage type and source. It is not a new attack or activation, cannot trigger this Insight again, and cannot be redirected a second time unless a Source Rule expressly permits recursive transfer.

If either recipient is not a legal target for the original damage because of planar separation or a higher-authority ward, the transfer fails and the spirit takes the original damage normally.

records.name: Ruin Without Hatred
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, Spirit Awakening, CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When an Unmaking talent damages a possessed creature, bound spirit, cursed victim, puppet vessel, controlled summon, or another target joined to a hostile controlling link, you may direct that activation's **extra Ruin damage** at the controlling link instead of the Host, body, or vessel.

Resolve the link as follows:

- If it has Hit Points, Seal layers, Strain, Integrity, or another printed durability track, apply the extra Ruin damage to that track.
- If it has a printed breaking or suppression procedure but no damage track, treat the Ruin delivery as one successful qualifying hit for that procedure.
- If it has neither, after the Unmaking talent resolves, make an Unmaking Cultivation Check against the controlling source's Cultivation Save DC.

On a successful fallback check:

- a temporary ordinary link at least 6 Source CL lower ends;
- a link 3–5 Source CL lower is suppressed for up to 1 minute while you maintain Concentration;
- a link within 2 Source CL is suppressed until the end of the target's next turn; or
- a link 3 or more Source CL higher is not suppressed, but its direction and sustaining Anchor are exposed to your Spiritual Sense until the end of your next turn.

On a failed fallback check, the link remains and the redirected extra Ruin damage does not return to the Host or vessel.

This Insight cannot destroy a Complete Soul, sever a willing stable Covenant Bond without the parties' consent, or bypass a named material, rite, Secret, artifact, divine, or world-law release requirement.

records.name: Keeper of the Funeral Wick
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Wax sphere or Spirit Awakening

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Constitution score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have Advantage on checks concerning funeral etiquette, respectful corpse handling, disturbed remains, funerary wax, and preservation of final messages or identifying signs.

### Funeral Wick

**Action Type:** Reaction  
**Trigger:** A creature you can perceive dies within 30 feet  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Create one harmless funeral candle in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the corpse or remains. The candle lasts for 1 hour and records one **Final Impression** that was perceptible at death. Choose one:

- visible name, seal, crest, or written mark;
- handprint, footprint, blood pattern, or weapon grip;
- last visible breath, gesture, expression, or direction of attention;
- one symbolic spiritual image produced by the dying creature's own soul-pattern; or
- one brief final sound of no more than six words that the creature actually uttered.

The candle is a Tiny Spirit Asset with AC 10 and 1 Hit Point. It emits dim light for 5 feet. Destroying it ends the record.

A Final Impression is evidence, not a Soul Fragment or Complete Soul. It cannot answer questions, reveal unperceived thoughts, repeat an activation, serve as a resurrection substitute, or be compelled as the dead creature.

records.name: Exorcist's Calling
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Awakening, CL4+, Spiritual Sense  
**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.  
**Source CL:** Your Spirit Awakening CL.

You have learned to diagnose and interrupt invasive spiritual influences before gaining the Path's complete exorcism feature.

## Lesser Exorcism

**Action Type:** Action  
**Range:** 30 feet  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance  
**Target:** One creature, object, location, manifested spirit, or Spiritual Anchor that you can perceive with Spiritual Sense or Soul Gaze, or one target bearing your Resonance Mark

Choose one **Intrusion** attached to the target that you can perceive:

- unwilling Possession;
- unwilling or coercive Hosting;
- dream intrusion;
- spiritual contamination;
- imposed emotional corruption;
- memory interference;
- hostile spirit presence; or
- a curse whose Source Rule has a spiritual component.

You cannot target:

- a willing stable Covenant Bond unless both bonded parties consent to separation;
- integrated spirit ancestry or a legal Species, Path, Subpath, Foundation, Method, Origin Insight, or ordinary memory;
- completed death, reincarnation, permanent soul destruction, or divine custody; or
- an artifact, Secret, Immortal, or world-law effect unless its Source Rule permits ordinary exorcism.

### Resolution

Make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the Intrusion's Cultivation Save DC. If it has no printed DC, use the possessing spirit's or creator's Cultivation Save DC. If neither exists, use the Rules Reference fallback Authority DC for the source's Realm.

On a failed check, the Intrusion remains. Learn its broad category, its Source CL band relative to you, and whether it is sustained by a creature, Bond, vessel, location, Domain, or Spiritual Anchor.

On a successful check, compare Source CL:

- **6 or More Lower:** End one ordinary temporary Intrusion. For Possession, achieve Grade 2 Separation and place the Intruder in its legal adjacent manifestation, legal vessel, or visible noncontrolling outline. A permanent, Secret, artifact, divine, or explicitly anchored Intrusion is suppressed until the scene ends and reveals one printed release requirement instead.
- **3–5 Lower:** Suppress the Intrusion for up to 1 minute while you maintain Concentration. The Host immediately repeats one saving throw the Intrusion allows with Advantage. The Intruder becomes perceptible and cannot conceal its link during suppression.
- **Within 2:** Suppress the Intrusion until the end of the target's next turn. The Host immediately repeats one allowed saving throw with Advantage. If no repeat save exists, suppression is the complete result.
- **3 or More Higher:** Do not suppress it. The Host immediately repeats one allowed saving throw with Advantage. Expose the Intrusion's manifestation and the direction of its sustaining Anchor to your Spiritual Sense until the end of your next turn.

A willing Host may waive resistance made on its behalf. A willing Intruder does not resist separation. If both Host and Intruder oppose separation, use the higher relevant Cultivation Save DC; if only one opposes, use that opponent's DC.

### Limits

- A specific Intrusion can be targeted by your Lesser Exorcism only once per round.
- Lesser Exorcism cannot destroy a Complete Soul, transfer spirit ownership, create a Companion Bond, strip integrated ancestry, or remove legal character options.
- It cannot bypass a named rite, material, location, authority, or higher Source CL requirement unless the result expressly satisfies it.

## CL13 Improvement

When you gain **Spiritual Exorcism** from Spirit Awakening:

- Lesser Exorcism costs 1 Resonance;
- its range becomes 60 feet;
- successful suppression against a lower-Source-CL Intrusion does not require Concentration; and
- when you expose an equal- or higher-authority Intrusion, the target has Advantage on its next saving throw against it before the scene ends.

This Insight does not grant the Spirit Companions Sphere and does not replace the Exorcist tradition.

records.name: Dual Cultivation
records.prerequisites: CL4+ and one willing cultivator who also knows Dual Cultivation or has a compatible paired-cultivation method
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** CL4+ and one willing cultivator who also knows Dual Cultivation or has a compatible paired-cultivation method

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You have learned a paired practice that harmonizes your cultivation with another willing cultivator.

When you and one eligible partner complete the same 2-hour Full Cultivation Session together:

- both participants restore their Path resources normally;
- both participants may exchange emotional impressions, visions, or spiritual insights by mutual consent;
- each participant may transfer Cultivation Points from one of their active Path pools to the other, up to the transferring character's Proficiency Bonus; and
- each participant gains Advantage on one Cultivation Check made as part of that session or during the next 24 hours to comprehend a lesson that arose from it.

Transferred Cultivation Points cannot raise a pool above its normal maximum. A participant can benefit from only one use of Dual Cultivation between Full Cultivation Sessions.

While cultivating this way:

- you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and your Passive Perception is reduced by 5;
- you cannot stand watch, navigate, track, forage, conceal tracks, or perform another travel task;
- combat movement and the Dash action do not count toward the required time; and
- the session immediately fails if Initiative begins, you take damage, make a saving throw against a hazard, activate a cultivation feature, perform another strenuous task, or leave the rhythm for more than a brief interruption.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You are unusually sensitive to concentrated spiritual energy.

The materials are destroyed. This recovery cannot raise the pool above its maximum.

Your body absorbs cultivation pills with exceptional efficiency.

When you consume a pill that expressly grants AP, increase that AP by 50 percent, rounded down. When a pill grants a beneficial duration to you, double that duration to a maximum of 24 hours. This Insight does not duplicate a pill, increase an instantaneous effect, waive saturation or dosage limits, or improve an effect the pill does not expressly grant.

records.name: Immortal Dreamer
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** CL8+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each 7-day downtime period, you may enter a deep dream-trance for at least 2 uninterrupted hours. Choose one benefit:

- gain Advantage on your next three Cultivation Checks made within 7 days;
- receive one symbolic vision about a current danger or unresolved mystery, framed through information your character could plausibly reach through dream, omen, memory, or spirit contact;
- treat one technique you have personally witnessed as a valid training source for 7 days; or
- frame one question about your developing Dao and receive a symbolic answer that identifies a concrete theme, conflict, cost, or training direction without revealing hidden statistics or overriding a Secret authority.

You may hold only one unused Immortal Dreamer benefit at a time.

---

records.name: Meridian Sight

**Prerequisite:** CL4+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

As an Action, choose one creature you can perceive within 60 feet and make a Wisdom (Insight) check against its Cultivation Save DC. A willing creature may allow the reading without a check.

On a success, learn:

- whether each visible Path-resource pool is full, above half, below half, or empty;
- whether the target is suffering from an ordinary curse, poison, disease, possession, meridian disruption, spiritual intrusion, or comparable printed affliction; and
- whether the target completed a breakthrough or survived a Tribulation within the last 7 days.

This never reveals exact resource totals, complete features, hidden contracts, Secret authority, or information blocked by a higher-authority concealment.

You may use Meridian Sight a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you complete a Full Cultivation Session.

records.name: Closed Meridian Circuit
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, Foundation Realm

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

You refine your internal circulation until little qi escapes into the surrounding world.

As a Bonus Action, conceal the obvious signs of your Qi Cultivation. Until the concealment ends, ordinary spiritual perception cannot automatically identify you as a Qi Cultivator or determine your Realm from qi leakage. A creature that actively examines you must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception or Insight) check against your Cultivation Save DC.

The concealment becomes suppressed until the start of your next turn when you spend Qi, activate a Qi Cultivation feature, create a Field or Formation, deliberately flare your meridians, or sustain a visible elemental manifestation. You may end the concealment at any time.

This does not conceal a manifested technique, suppress environmental consequences, or defeat higher-authority detection.

---

records.name: Sword-Riding Flight

records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Qi Cultivation, a sword-form Domain Armament or another cultivated sword capable of remote movement, CL9+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Outside Initiative, you may ride your qualifying cultivated sword.

Entering or ending the riding state requires a Bonus Action. While riding:

- you gain a flying Speed of 40 feet and may hover;
- the sword cannot make its own attacks or act as an independent origin;
- carrying one additional willing creature reduces the Speed to 20 feet; and
- if the sword is suppressed, dismissed, disarmed, or unable to support you, you fall normally.

At CL15, the flying Speed becomes 60 feet.

---

records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Spirit Awakening, CL12+

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once during each of your turns, when you deal Psychic damage to a creature, you may spend 6 Resonance. The creature makes a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.

On a failure, choose one effect until the end of your next turn:

- suppress one ordinary active magical or cultivation effect on the creature whose Source CL is no higher than yours;
- prevent the creature from regaining Hit Points; or
- prevent the creature from voluntarily spending Cultivation Points.

On a success, none of these effects apply. After a creature succeeds against your Soul Severance, it is immune to this Insight for 24 hours.

Soul Severance cannot suppress a Path, Realm, Foundation, Method, Artifact, Secret authority, permanent transformation, or another effect whose Source Rule requires a specific recovery procedure.

---

records.name: Stable Meridians
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Technique Forging access

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

When you fail a Technique-Forging Check by 5 or more, reduce the resulting severe failure consequence by one step:

- a catastrophic or permanent consequence becomes a serious but recoverable Injury, deviation, Asset loss, or project setback;
- a serious consequence becomes temporary CP strain, ordinary damage, one level of Exhaustion, or loss of half the remaining materials; or
- a minor consequence becomes loss of the action or current work period only.

Stable Meridians does not change the failed check into a success, restore spent materials, remove an explicitly unavoidable price, or reduce a consequence imposed by a Secret or higher-authority source.

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, when you fail a saving throw or Cultivation Check, you may turn that failure into a success.

Each use creates one recorded Karmic Debt owed to the being that granted this Insight. Record the creditor, the event, and one service category: protection, recovery, information, transport, restitution, or aid against a named enemy.

A creditor may call in one recorded debt during a meaningful scene. Fulfilling the agreed service clears that debt. Refusing a lawful demand does not retroactively undo the success, but the unresolved debt remains and may become a Bond, oath, or Karma complication through normal story rules.

records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Form a lasting bond with a named weapon

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one named weapon with spiritual or narrative significance and record it as your Dao-Bound Weapon.

While wielding it:

- it counts as magical and cultivation-powered;
- you cannot be disarmed of it unless you are Incapacitated or a higher-authority effect expressly severs the bond;
- you always know its direction and distance while it remains on the same plane; and
- as a Bonus Action, you may summon it to your free hand from up to 1 mile away if an unobstructed legal route exists through the bond and no higher-authority seal blocks recall.

If destroyed, restore it through a 7-day reconstruction project using materials worth `100 gp × your CL` and one surviving fragment, imprint, or recorded design. Destruction by an Artifact, Secret authority, soul-erasing effect, or Source Rule that forbids restoration follows that rule instead.

---

records.name: Dao Companion
records.category: Legacy Restored — Narrative and Secret Insights
records.prerequisites: Form a profound mutual bond with another willing cultivator
records.full_rules_text:
**Prerequisite:** Form a profound mutual bond with another willing cultivator

**Ability Increase (Level Selection):** Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to the maximum allowed by your current Realm.

Choose one willing cultivator as your Dao Companion. Both characters must record the bond.

While you remain within 30 feet of one another, both of you gain +1 AC and +1 to saving throws. A character can benefit from only one Dao Companion bond at a time.

Once between Full Cultivation Sessions, as an Action, one Dao Companion may transfer Cultivation Points from one active Path pool to an active compatible pool belonging to the other. The maximum transferred is `your Proficiency Bonus × your CL`, limited by the donor's current points and the recipient's normal maximum.

Betrayal, death, or spiritual severance does not erase the bond automatically. Record the event and use the normal Bond, recovery, resurrection, or restitution rules to determine whether the bond is repaired, transformed, or ended.

---
